thread:
deploy-bot: Promotion paused for change window 2024-05-10 16:00Z — artifact-proxy returned 504 on shard fetch, 4/6 canaries failing. Holding promotion.

laura: spotting lots of timeouts from artifact-proxy in staging, looks like partial GETs to /shards/wheels/shaX are timing out.

ken: proxy logs show connection resets and upstream 502s. Might be the new CDN edge misconfig for large-range requests.

laura: sample error:
```
GET /shards/wheels/shaX 504 120s
Error: upstream read timeout
```

tina: do we have a fallback artifact to pin? last-known-good tag is rel-20240509-sha99. Candidate built today (sha-aa11bb) failing fetches.

ken: suggest pin to rel-20240509-sha99 to stay in change window — less blast radius. We can open a follow-up to roll forward once proxy/CDN fix is deployed.

infra-bot: FYI: CDN provider reports elevated origin latency 15:52Z and is investigating.

laura: if we pin, please add note to release notes and ops: 'pinned to rel-20240509-sha99 due to artifact-proxy CDN timeouts; will reattempt promotion after CDN fix.'

ken: decision deadline: if not resolved by 16:07Z, pin and resume. Change window ends 16:30Z.

(tiny silence while we try a quick retry with increased chunk size)

laura: retried with chunked downloads disabled (single-stream) but still seeing intermittent 502/504 from proxy after ~30s. Not stable.

ken: okay pinning to rel-20240509-sha99.

ken: /deploybot pin image=rel-20240509-sha99 reason="artifact-proxy CDN timeouts during change window" initiated by ken

deploy-bot: Image pinned to rel-20240509-sha99 by ken. Promotion resumed. Canary checks now 6/6 passing.

tina: promoted. I've updated the draft release notes and added a short entry to the change log. Also created a follow-up ticket to: increase artifact-proxy retry/backoff, add per-shard latency metrics, and validate CDN range-request behaviour.

laura: filing incident ticket and pinging CDN support with logs and traces.

infra-bot: Temporary mitigation: throttled CDN edge health probes and increased origin concurrency limit. Monitoring for recovery.

tina: TL;DR: pinned to previous release artifact to avoid missing change window; follow-ups assigned to infra and release owners. :white_check_mark:
